title: Hinomori Shizuku — Calm For The Hard Workers〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Outside the MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's already getting dark...
The day just flew by while we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But I feel that we improved quite a lot today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We are able to do a lot more when we sing and dance now. So, let's maintain this momentum and keep doing our best tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right. Oh, Airi...
Would it be alright if I went over to that vending machine to buy a drink?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No problem. I emptied my bottle while practicing, so I think I'll also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I left my bottle in the practice room!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shizuku, I'll be right back.
Can you wait here for me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. But it's not like you to forget this sort of thing, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I must be more exhausted from practice than I realized. Anyway, be right back...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, but there's no rush.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is Airi okay...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Minori and Haruka have also seemed rather tired in recent days.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wish there were a way for me to help relieve them of their fatigue. Even just a little bit, so they can keep doing their best during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...!
The next day
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There we are.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, wonderful...! They're just in time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, Minori, your socks don't match.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? No, you're right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Geez, it's always the textbook flubs with you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They're so full of energy this morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku, morning!
We didn't realize you were already here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, there was something that I wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something you wanted to do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that those have something to do with it. Check out what's on the table.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, these flowers are adorable!
The petals are arranged like little stars!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're called pentas. Some compare the flowers to shooting stars, and say they symbolize your hopes and dreams coming true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's beautiful.
And they really help brighten up this room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad you all like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But why'd you decide to get these all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Between practicing very hard and coming up with stream ideas, I've noticed that you've all been incredibly busy lately...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I hoped some cute flowers would help you relax.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I brewed some herbal tea for us to have during our meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I was wondering what smelled so nice.
It was your tea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and it should be ready in just another minute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, Shizuku, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, in the meantime, why don't we start setting up for our meeting?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for waiting. It's very hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What a soothing aroma...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's lavender tea, and its aroma is in fact supposed to be quite relaxing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also bought some mizu-yokan if you like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, the packaging's covered in cute flowers.
It's nice how they're bite-sized too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I made sure to get low-sugar ones, so I hope you try them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll take one.
Mmm... This is really good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're not too sweet, so they go really well with this tea. I do feel nice and relaxed now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! We have these cute flowers, this herbal tea and some really yummy Japanese sweets...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My mind and body are in such a great place right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. Being able to relax like this should help us come up with good ideas during our meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for doing all this for us, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad that I could help you all somehow.
